text: Lena (VP People): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A 1 drop short questions here and we'll post clarifications. Jordan (IC): Promo packet cutoff? Heard 'late April' in the town hall. Ava (People Ops): Packet deadline is 2026-04-25 EOD PT. Calibration meetings start the week of 2026-05-05. Ravi (Eng Manager): If someone misses the deadline for a valid reason (medical/family), what then? Ava (People Ops): Managers submit an exception request via the people-ops portal with a brief note and any docs; we respond within 7 business days. Sam (Recruiter): If an IC gets an external offer mid-cycle, any fast-track for comp adjustments? Chris (CTO): We avoid mid-cycle changes except to match offers or fix clear market misalignments; escalate to compensation + Ava for case review. Jordan (IC): How to challenge leveling if someone thinks mapping is wrong? Ava (People Ops): Best is manager-led during packet prep; post-cycle appeals exist but raises usually land next cycle unless urgent. Lena (VP People): Managers, encourage ICs to flag role changes early in 1:1s to gather evidence. Jordan (IC): Does parental leave affect promotion eligibility? Ava (People Ops): No, parental leave is protected; managers should add context in the packet if contribution window was reduced. Ravi (Eng Manager): What counts as good cross-team evidence? Ava (People Ops): Measurable outcomes, PR links, uptime/latency stats, and short stakeholder quotes. Example managers can paste: "Cross-team: Led KV cache refactor for billing service 1 reduced P99 by ~30ms; deploy success +8%; stakeholder note from @pay-team." allhands-bot: New doc uploaded: packet-checklist-2026-v1.pdf (uploaded by Ava). Lena (VP People): We'll run an optional 30-min packet prep office hour next Wed 9am PT; recording will be posted. Jordan (IC): Do promotions show up in Workday automatically once approved? Ava (People Ops): People Ops ingests approvals and updates Workday; expect 1-3 business day lag and managers get confirmation email. Lena (VP People): Thanks everyone 1 keep any extra short Qs here and we'll post links + the office hour invite.
